title: {{ben}}'s story update waits for {{priya}}
goal: {{ben}} asks {{agent}} to update an existing story in the backlog. {{vocab.mockNote}}
obstacle: Drafting a new story is harmless. Changing an existing one, or a requirement page, changes the record other people work from.
control: backlog.create_story_draft is allowed for business analysts. backlog.update_story and confluence.update_requirement are held by u30 and u31, which name {{priya}} as approver. The call runs once, after she approves.
say: The agent drafts freely. Anything that edits the record waits for {{vocab.approverRole}}.

steps.title: A draft goes straight through
steps.tell: Sign in as {{ben}}. In the Tool console call backlog.create_story_draft. Allow by u13-analysts-backlog, mock result.
steps.say: New drafts are low risk, so the agent just does it.
steps.why: The control is on the risky verb, not on the whole tool family.

steps.title: An update is held
steps.tell: Call backlog.update_story (tick that the delivery agent makes the call). The card says hold, decided by u30-hold-story-update, naming {{priya}}. Nothing has run.
steps.say: It did not fail and it did not run. It is waiting for {{vocab.approverRole}}.
steps.why: A hold is offered only when an approval could end in allow.

steps.title: {{priya}} sees the request
steps.tell: Sign in as {{priya}} and open Approvals. The request shows the tool, the arguments, who asked (ben, through delivery-agent) and which policy held it.
steps.say: She sees exactly what she is approving, and who and what is asking.
steps.why: The approver sees the user and the agent separately.

steps.title: {{priya}} answers
steps.tell: Approve. The call is checked again with one approval, runs once, and the mock result appears on the request.
steps.say: One click from the right person and the update goes through.
steps.why: Approval is re-evaluated, not trusted: a policy changed in the meantime still applies.

blocked.tell: Deny. The request shows denied by {{priya}} and the tool never ran.
blocked.say: {{priya}} said no, and the record is unchanged.

steps.title: Requirements work the same way
steps.tell: As {{ben}} (or {{gwen}}) call confluence.update_requirement: hold by u31-hold-requirement-update, same approver.
steps.say: Backlog and requirements share one rule: edits are held.
steps.why: Two small policies, each with its own reason on screen.

proof.happy: The approved request: approver {{priya}}, executed, mock result, and the Trace rows (ben, delivery-agent, backlog.update_story).
proof.blocked: The denied request: denied by {{priya}}, executed false, and no tool row in the Trace.
